comment: Approved-dashboard reconciliation anchors for the per-member Management Report. Values are the signed-off FY2025-26 dashboard figures; money is in rupees (Cr x 1e7). The verify endpoint compares the app's computed secondary-order-booking report against these. For each metric the listed tolerance is the pass band; twice that band is the warn band; beyond is fail. moneyPassPct/countPassPct are percentages of the expected value; memberCountAbs is an absolute member count.
